name: journalctl
description: Query logs generated by journald, the systemd logging service.

options.description: Show messages for the specified systemd unit.
Show journal messages and continuously print new entries as they appear.
Show the most recent journal entries, specified count.

examples.output: Oct 12 10:00:01 server sshd[789]: Server listening on 0.0.0.0 port 22.
examples.explanation: Displays last 10 log entries for ssh.
